Calibration stages

Source: R/staged.R
pdm_stages.Rd

The stages of a staged calibration, following how a hydrologist calibrates by hand: settle the water balance and the slow response first, then the fast response, then a short joint polish.

Usage

pdm_stages(
  config,
  overrides = NULL,
  exclude = NULL,
  polish = TRUE,
  volume_weight = 1,
  band = 0.25
)

Arguments

config

A configuration list.

overrides, exclude

Passed to calibration_bounds().

polish

Include stage 3.

volume_weight

Weight of the volume penalty in stage 1.

band

Half-width of the stage 3 search, as a fraction of each range.

Value

A list of stages.

Details

StageFitsObjective
1. Volume and baseflowfc, soil store, recharge, groundwater1 - log NSE + volume error
2. Fast responseSurface stores and the store shape b1 - NSE
3. PolishEverything, within narrowed bounds1 - NSE

Low flows and the total volume depend on the slow stores, and logs stop the floods dominating stage 1. Peak size and timing depend on the fast stores, fitted in stage 2 with stage 1's values fixed. Stage 3 starts from the stage 2 result and searches a band of a quarter of each parameter's range either side, on the search scale, to fix interactions the stages missed without drifting far.

Parameters come from calibration_bounds(), so every structure gets its own lists: a split recharge adds recharge.alpha to stage 1, an exponential store adds its two parameters. A stage is a plain list, so you can write your own: name, parameters (configuration paths), objective (as in calibrate_pdm()), volume_weight and band (NULL, or the half-width of the narrowed search, as a fraction of each parameter's range).

See also

calibrate_staged(), log_staged_calibration()

Examples

str(pdm_stages(pdm_presets("standard")), max.level = 2)
#> List of 3
#>  $ :List of 5
#>   ..$ name         : chr "volume and baseflow"
#>   ..$ parameters   : chr [1:5] "fc" "distribution.cmax" "distribution.b" "recharge.kg" ...
#>   ..$ objective    : chr "log_nse"
#>   ..$ volume_weight: num 1
#>   ..$ band         : NULL
#>  $ :List of 5
#>   ..$ name         : chr "fast response"
#>   ..$ parameters   : chr [1:3] "distribution.b" "surface.k1" "surface.k2"
#>   ..$ objective    : chr "nse"
#>   ..$ volume_weight: num 0
#>   ..$ band         : NULL
#>  $ :List of 5
#>   ..$ name         : chr "polish"
#>   ..$ parameters   : chr [1:7] "fc" "distribution.cmax" "distribution.b" "recharge.kg" ...
#>   ..$ objective    : chr "nse"
#>   ..$ volume_weight: num 0
#>   ..$ band         : num 0.25
